title: ग्रामर: बीता हुआ समय (past tense)
Grammar: beeta hua samay (past tense)
Grammar in Use: the past tense

card: बीती बात के लिए क्रिया का दूसरा रूप। ज़्यादातर में -ed लगता है: cook → cooked, play → played। कुछ बिल्कुल बदल जाते हैं: write → wrote, give → gave।
Beeti baat ke liye kriya ka doosra roop. Zyaadatar mein -ed lagta hai: cook → cooked, play → played. Kuch bilkul badal jaate hain: write → wrote, give → gave.
For the past, use the past form. Most verbs add -ed: cook → cooked, play → played. Some change completely: write → wrote, give → gave.

pairs: हर क्रिया को उसके बीते रूप से जोड़ो (-ed वाले)
Har kriya ko uske beete roop se jodo (-ed waale)
Join each verb to its past form (-ed)
ये क्रियाएँ बदल जाती हैं — बीते रूप से जोड़ो

These verbs change — join them to their past forms

card: y पर ख़त्म होने वाले शब्द: y हटाकर -ied: try → tried, fry → fried, copy → copied। कुछ शब्द नहीं बदलते: put → put, hit → hit, read → read (पर ‘रेड’ बोलते हैं), cut → cut।
y par khatm hone waale shabd: y hataakar -ied: try → tried, fry → fried, copy → copied. Kuch shabd nahi badalte: put → put, hit → hit, read → read (par ‘red’ bolte hain), cut → cut.
Words ending in y: drop y and add -ied: try → tried, fry → fried, copy → copied. Some don't change: put → put, hit → hit, read → read (said ‘red’), cut → cut.
